title: Blinding Lights

cues.en: I've been on my own for long enough
cues.zh: 我已經獨自生活了足夠長的時間
cues.text: I've been on my own for long enough

cues.en: Maybe you can show me how to love
cues.zh: 也許你可以告訴我如何去愛
cues.text: Maybe you can show me how to love

cues.en: You don't even have to do too much
cues.text: You don't even have to do too much

cues.en: You can tell me I'm just a touch
cues.zh: 你可以告訴我我只是輕輕一碰
cues.text: You can tell me I'm just a touch

cues.en: No one's around to judge me
cues.text: No one's around to judge me

cues.en: I can see clearly when you're gone
cues.zh: 當你離開時我可以清楚地看到
cues.text: I can see clearly when you're gone

cues.en: Oh, oh I blind by the lights
cues.text: Oh, oh I blind by the lights

cues.en: Now I can sleep in it till I feel your heart touch
cues.zh: 現在我可以睡在裡面直到我感覺到你的心觸動
cues.text: Now I can sleep in it till I feel your heart touch

cues.en: Oh, oh I'm drowning in the night
cues.text: Oh, oh I'm drowning in the night

cues.en: Oh, oh I don't like this
cues.text: Oh, oh I don't like this

cues.en: Cause I can see the sunlight up the sky
cues.zh: 因為我可以看到天空中的陽光
cues.text: Cause I can see the sunlight up the sky

cues.en: So I hit the road and overdrive
cues.zh: 所以我上路並超速行駛
cues.text: So I hit the road and overdrive

cues.en: No one's around to judge me
cues.text: No one's around to judge me

cues.en: My kids ain't clearly where you're going
cues.zh: 我的孩子們不清楚你要去哪裡
cues.text: My kids ain't clearly where you're going

cues.en: No, I can't sleep until I feel your heart touch
cues.zh: 不，除非我感覺到你的心觸動，否則我無法入睡
cues.text: No, I can't sleep until I feel your heart touch

cues.en: I'm just coming back to let you know
cues.text: I'm just coming back to let you know

cues.en: I can never say it all before
cues.zh: 我以前永遠無法說出這一切
cues.text: I can never say it all before

cues.en: No, I'm not the let you go
cues.text: No, I'm not the let you go
